question_text: Outline two advantages of a linked list over a fixed-size array for an ordered register with frequent additions and deletions.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A node can be inserted/deleted by changing links once the position is known, avoiding shifts of later items. Nodes can be allocated as needed, avoiding a predetermined array capacity.

marking_points.criterion: Explains capacity flexibility without claiming zero memory overhead.
